summary: This Form 6-K filed by Studio City International Holdings Limited (SCIHL) discloses a subsidiary's pricing of US$300 million 6.125% senior secured notes due 2031. The proceeds, with cash on hand, will fund a conditional cash tender offer to repurchase all outstanding 7.00% senior secured notes due 2027 and redeem any remaining. The new notes are senior secured, guaranteed by certain subsidiaries but not by Melco Resorts or SCIHL. This is a refinancing transaction (a notes-for-notes exchange/tender) rather than a special situation; there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. The filing describes a routine debt capital markets transaction and tender offer. Risk-arb angle: monitor tender offer completion and redemption mechanics.
